blocks.text: Roshni ki fitrat aik mushkil sawal raha hai. Kya roshni tawanai aik jagah se doosri jagah lehar ki shakal mein le jati hai ya zarrat ki dhaar ki shakal mein? Lehar aik chalti hui gharbar (disturbance) hai jo tawanai le ja sakti hai, aur roshni kai mazahir mein lehar jaisa bartao dikhati hai, lekin doosri lehron ke bar-aks is ki fitrat wazeh nahi.

Roshni ki lehar wali fitrat pehli dafa 1678 mein Christiaan Huygens ne pesh ki, lekin us waqt saboot qaail karne wale na the, aur Newton ki 1672 ki zarrati (corpuscular) theory zyada maqbool thi. 1801 ke Young ke interference tajurbe ne roshni ki lehar wali fitrat dikhayi aur Huygens ki lehar theory qaim ki. 1860 mein Maxwell ne roshni ko electromagnetic lehar bataya: jhoolte bijli ke charges badalte bijli aur magnetic fields paida karte hain jo aik doosre ko dobara paida karte aur khala mein safar karte hain. Beesvi sadi ke shuru mein quantum mechanics ne dikhaya ke roshni ki dohri fitrat hai: yeh electromagnetic lehar ki tarah safar karti lekin maddah se photons naam ke alag, be-kamiyat zarrat ki tarah amal karti hai. Lehar ki theory ab bhi roshni ki bohat si khasiyatein samjhati hai, aur yeh chapter in mein se do, interference aur diffraction, parhta hai.

blocks.prompt: Kis tajurbe ne roshni ki lehar theory qaim ki, aur kab?
blocks.explanation: Young ka double-slit interference tajurba, 1801 mein.

items: Young (1801): interference ne lehar wali fitrat sabit ki; Maxwell (1860): electromagnetic lehrein.
